external_entities.name: other teams' backends
external_entities.description: Backends operated by other teams that call the inference gateway.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway

external_entities.name: ML engineers
external_entities.description: People who publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.

processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service on GKE that receives inference requests and forwards them to the model server, and writes requests and responses to the inference log.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE
processes.notes: Keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired.

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The service that runs the actual model on GPU nodes, loads model artifacts, and reads customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes
processes.notes: The model server uses its own service account to load model artifacts.

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket storing model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup and published by ML engineers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: model artifacts from a model registry bucket
data_stores.notes: The source says, "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features including account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Redis feature store on the same network
data_stores.notes: Redis has no password and is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts that users may have typed.
data_stores.source_excerpt: an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging
data_stores.notes: The log contains raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.name: call gateway
data_flows.description: Other teams' backends call the inference gateway with inference requests.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
data_flows.data_description: Inference requests, potentially containing user-typed prompts.

data_flows.name: forward request
data_flows.description: The inference gateway forwards requests to the model server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway forwards the request to the model server
data_flows.notes: There is no authentication between the gateway and the model server.

data_flows.name: load artifacts
data_flows.description: The model server loads model artifacts from the model registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.notes: The model server uses its own service account. The source says, "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_flows.name: read features
data_flows.description: The model server reads customer features from the Redis feature store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the model server reads from a Redis feature store on the same network
data_flows.notes: Redis has no password on it.
data_flows.data_description: Customer features, including account age and spend bands per customer.

data_flows.name: write log
data_flows.description: The gateway writes every request and response into the inference log for debugging.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_flows.data_description: Every inference request and response, including raw prompts.

data_flows.name: publish artifacts
data_flows.description: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the model registry bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
data_flows.notes: The source says, "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account." This is a hedge, so authentication remains unknown.

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: The network context from which the inference gateway is exposed.

trust_boundaries.name: model network
trust_boundaries.description: The network containing the GPU nodes running the model server and the Redis feature store, intended to be reachable only from the gateway.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the model network is meant to be reachable only from the gateway

assumptions.assumption: The customer features are confidential because they include account age and spend bands per customer.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the feature store contains account age and spend bands per customer, which are customer-related and commercially sensitive data.
